R7AB-moose-backcountry-0003.name: 850 m NE of Guilford Creek
R7AB-moose-backcountry-0003.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R7AB-moose-backcountry-0003.parkWhat: pull off on Penny St (gravel road)

evidence.t: 7 wetlands within 2 km; nearest 5.8 ha, 560 m SE.
Cutblock harvested 2020 (6 years old), 940 m W: browse.

flags.t: Route crosses protected area: Ancient Forest/Chun T'oh Whudujut Protected Area. Hunting only where that park allows it, in open season. Check its bcparks.ca page (synopsis page 9, 99%).
Route crosses private land (ParcelMap BC, updated 2026-10-05): get permission first or go around.

plan: Drive: from City of Prince George, about 129 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 97 (Hart Hwy), Northwood Pulpmill Rd, industrial access, Beaver Forest Rd.
Park: 53.83203, -121.26062, pull off on Penny St (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 5.7 km E, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 162 m, about 130 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 220 m SE of the spot at 719 m (53.8318, -121.17087). Water: unnamed wetland 330 m E (estimate).
Hunt: moose, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-17, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-05, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AB-moose-backcountry-0003.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-17: about 1,422 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.52 days per square km, top third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
